memories.content: Khrushchev is the leader of the Soviet Union. He is aware of the US quarantine announcement and is considering his options. He may choose to communicate directly with President Kennedy via letter.

On October 22, 1962, President Kennedy announced a quarantine of Cuba in response to the discovery of Soviet missile sites. The world is watching the escalating crisis. Direct letters between the leaders are a possible channel of communication.
